verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe running the full stack via Docker Compose (API, front-end, MongoDB) for self-hosting, plus a proxy for caching/resilience, and community evidence confirms real-world self-hosted usage over months. Evaluation data stays local since SDKs cache a JSON payload and evaluate locally, with raw attribute values never sent to GrowthBook. Missing for 10: independent verification of full production-scale reliability and more detailed infra/security hardening guidance beyond the quickstart docs.
